title: 2024 HMMT November General Problem 2
statement: Let \(R A N D O M\) be a regular hexagon with side length 1 . Points \(I\) and \(T\) lie on segments \(\overline{R A}\) and \(\overline{D O}\), respectively, such that \(M I=M T\) and \(\angle T M I=90^{\circ}\). Compute the area of triangle \(M I T\).

solutions.text:
By symmetry, \(I T\) must be perpendicular to \(R A\) and \(D O\). Therefore, the length of \(I T\) is the height of the hexagon, which is \(\sqrt{3}\). So, the area of triangle \(M I T\) is \(\frac{1}{4} I T^{2}=\frac{3}{4}\).
